title.narrative: Land Management for Investment Project

description.narrative: Solomon Islands Threshold - Land Management For Investments Projects: the Access Land for Tourism Investment Facilitation Project (ALTIF) will address the land access and investment facilitation issues to help the country grow its tourism sector. The ALTIF Project seeks to achieve this objective by building government capacity to identify investable land and facilitate investment in the sector. The ALTIF Project aims to increase tourism investment in Solomon Islands, which is expected to deliver jobs and productivity gains, increased local purchases, and foreign exchange benefits.

title.narrative: Number of gender/inclusion recommendations

description.narrative:
Cumulative Output of Preliminary data pending evidence submission.
IFC took a workshop approach to present a greater number of recommendations to a greater number of potential clients (ALTIF stakeholders and TITF members). They anticipate implementing only a very small number of these recommendations with 1 or 2 client agencies, so the Outcome target is unchanged at 2, despite 18 recommendations being made across Component 1 and Component 2. Exceeding the Output target with this rationale (vs. original design logic of identifying the client first and then delivering only 1-2 recommendations) is allowable under IFC M&E governance.
Land recommendations: Identify a Diverse Consultation Team: Ensure that women and people with disabilities are included in the consultation team to better capture gender and disability related issues and challenges in communities. Communicate inclusive expectations to consultants or external events companies: if event planning or meetings are outsourced, ensure that accessibility and provision of reasonable accommodations are part of the requirements for services. Plan to include diverse stakeholders in consultations: �Nothing without us�: Ensure that a diverse group of stakeholders are consulted, including women and people with disabilities. Schedule events to maximize participation: Ensure that consultations are conducted at a time where women are not involved in other regular activities. Ensure that accessibility provisions are built in and adequate breaks are scheduled. Provide adequate notice to stakeholders and adequate time to conduct the consultation. Select an accessible and safe location: Ensure that consultations are conducted in an accessible and safe location with adequate facilities. Good practice � conduct an accessibility audit and consider proximity to accessible transport/accommodation. Ensure that all communications are accessible: How is information communicated to and issues collected from those who cannot read or who have vision, hearing or other impairments � consider subtitles, sign language interpreters. Evaluate the effectiveness of the consultation: Ask for feedback from women and people with disabilities after the event. What worked, what did not? What needs to be adjusted for next time? Ensure that all data captured is disaggregated � is all the information collected disaggregated?
